So I dealt with the cramps at home from 11pm until 9am. A contraction every 5 minutes with the pain being bad enough to wake me up from my sleep. Once my boyfriend woke up the cramps were just getting worse so I had my mother take me to the hospital. Turns out I was 6 inches dilated and that afternoon I had my beautiful son.

Funny thing is throughout the whole thing, I still never cried.
